q: Wrexham were founded in 1864, making them the oldest football club in which country?
hint: They are also among the oldest professional clubs anywhere in the world, though they compete in the English league system.

q: Which two Hollywood actors bought Wrexham in 2021?
o: Michael B. Jordan and Idris Elba
hint: Their takeover became the subject of the documentary series Welcome to Wrexham.

q: What is the name of Wrexham's home ground?
hint: It is recognised as the world's oldest international football stadium still hosting international matches.

q: Wrexham ended a 15-year absence from the English Football League by winning which division in 2023?
hint: They went up as champions after several near-misses in the play-offs.

q: In one of the FA Cup's great upsets in 1992, Wrexham beat which reigning league champions?
hint: Wrexham had finished bottom of the entire Football League the previous season, and won 2-1.

q: Which veteran Wrexham player scored the famous free-kick in that 1992 cup upset?
hint: Thomas, then 37, curled it in past a wall before Steve Watkin added the winner.

q: By what nickname are Wrexham known?
hint: The dragon is the emblem of Wales and appears on the national flag.

q: Wrexham hold the record for winning which competition the most times?
hint: They have lifted it 23 times, more than any other club in its history.

q: Which striker became the face of Wrexham's rise, scoring prolifically in the promotion seasons?
hint: Mullin joined from Cambridge United in 2021 and his goals drove the National League title win.

q: What is the name of the documentary series following Wrexham's Hollywood era?
hint: It won multiple Emmy awards and brought the club a global audience far beyond its division.

q: Despite being a Welsh club, Wrexham compete in which league system?
hint: Several Welsh clubs, including Cardiff City and Swansea City, do the same for historical reasons.

q: In 1976 Wrexham reached the quarter-finals of which European competition?
hint: They qualified through the Welsh Cup, the route that took several Welsh clubs into Europe in that era.

q: What colour shirts do Wrexham traditionally wear at home?
hint: The red shirt matches both the nickname and the dragon of the Welsh flag.

q: Wrexham's famous 1992 FA Cup win over the reigning champions came in which round?
hint: The tie was played on 4 January 1992, the traditional third-round weekend when the big clubs enter.

q: Before the 2021 takeover, Wrexham had been owned since 2011 by whom?
hint: The Wrexham Supporters Trust ran the club for a decade and voted to approve the Reynolds and McElhenney takeover.

q: Wrexham's ground has hosted home matches for which national team?
hint: The Racecourse Ground staged Welsh internationals for well over a century, which is the basis of its record.
